notes:
Summary: mid-market SaaS (customer support platform) evaluating Redwood Hosted API as primary route, exploring Dedicated for predictable capacity once traffic grows. Primary workload = live agent-assist chat with streaming responses + tool-calling (CRM lookups, ticket open/close).

Requirements / constraints: 
- Latency: strict first-token SLO < 1.5s (goal: <1.2s); 99th percentile under peak concurrency required.
- Streaming required for UX (progressive rendering to agents).
- Tool calling: must support reliable function calls to Salesforce/Zendesk; deterministic fallback when tool times out.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; prefers usage-based with cap or Dedicated commit for predictable unit cost.
- Data controls: need SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration, and potential EU data residency for subset of customers.

POC details and metrics: 
- POC config: Hosted API, streaming enabled, gpt-style open model variants (customer open to quantized weights for latency).
- Load profile: 40 rps sustained, 120 concurrent agent sessions peak, mean session tokens ~150.
- Success criteria: 99p first-token <1.5s; streaming stability (no chunk drops) for 6h continuous runs; tool-call roundtrip <500ms median when services healthy.

Sales / pricing notes: 
- LumenAssist asked for Hosted API pricing first; wants Dedicated quote for a 12-month commit if POC meets SLOs.
- Estimated ARR range provided to customer: $25k-$100k ARR depending on commit level + add-on observability.
